question: Should Workspaces ship an inline custom-widget approval queue and a Busy/Idle-only agent-status built-in as the supported operations-widget scope?
rationale: The approval path reuses existing authority, but exposing it inline and narrowing the linked status request from awaiting-input-aware live state to Busy/Idle are product and security-surface choices rather than mechanical fixes.

options.title: Approve the narrowed widgets
options.body: Accept the inline operator approval surface and Busy/Idle scope after session-event refresh and real browser proof are added.

options.title: Status widget only
options.body: Land live agent status after fixing freshness, while leaving approval decisions on the existing dedicated approval surface.

options.title: Pause both widgets
options.body: Keep the roadmap issues open until maintainers define a broader operations-widget contract and authorization UX.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrowed widgets
recommendation.body: Accept the inline operator approval surface and Busy/Idle scope after session-event refresh and real browser proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the current Workspaces product and authorization boundary that this choice extends.
